_about: ElevenLabs sound effects (POST /v1/sound-generation), 2026-11-23. model eleven_text_to_sound_v2, output mp3_44100_128; loop true where marked. Kept from the first version: sfx-crown (crowd roar at the crown), sfx-fall (the collapse), sfx-tile (floors up and down) — their prompts below.

s-embers-loop.prompt: Close, soft crackle of glowing embers in a dying fire at night, gentle pops and ticks, no wind, no voices, seamless loop

s-fire-loop.prompt: Deep low roar of a large bonfire with a slow breathing whoosh and dense crackling, warm rumble, no wind, no voices, seamless loop

s-breath-loop.prompt: A crowd of people breathing slowly together in a quiet room, soft deep inhales and exhales, close and warm, no talking, seamless loop
s-breath-loop.use: pinya (and faintly in the intro, 20–50 s)

s-wind-loop.prompt: High altitude night wind on a rooftop, thin airy whistle, soft gusts, vast and empty, no rain, seamless loop
s-wind-loop.use: pom, on a slow rotor; gusts on climber:n

s-rain-loop.prompt: Small pieces of glass and ceramic shards gently raining down onto stone, delicate tinkling and ticking, sparse and calm, seamless loop

s-crowd-loop.prompt: Large festive crowd in an outdoor town square at night, cheering, clapping and murmuring in waves, echo off stone buildings, no music, seamless loop
s-crowd-loop.use: festa/crown, on a rotor that speeds with resonance

s-bells.prompt: Distant church bells ringing slowly over a sleeping city at night, heard from far away, long reverberant tail
s-bells.use: intro (2.5 s far wall, at 0.947 = D; 46 s, lower)

s-tabals.prompt: A fast roll of deep festival street drums building quickly and ending on one huge booming hit, outdoors, cinematic
s-tabals.use: brasa wave: one copy per wall, 0.16 s apart, round the room

s-ember-burst.prompt: A short burst of fire sparks: a quick whoosh, sizzling crackle and fizzing embers, close

s-clay.prompt: A hand pressing firmly into soft wet clay, a muffled warm thump with a soft body resonance, close

s-ceramic.prompt: A single small glazed ceramic tile struck lightly with a fingertip, bright clear ring, short
s-ceramic.use: tronc / festa / baixada hand transient, re-pitched (its ring is ~1605 Hz)

s-impact.prompt: A deep cinematic impact with a sub bass drop and a long dark reverberant tail, trailer hit
s-impact.use: brasa awake (REVERSED: a 5 s swell), fall

s-crack.prompt: Dry clay hardening and cracking into pieces, ceramic fracture, crisp crackles over a low groan
s-crack.use: pinya reward: the clay cracks into trencadís

s-gralla.prompt: A single long sustained note played on a gralla, a loud bright Catalan double-reed shawm, steady pitch, solo, dry, no melody
s-gralla.use: the granular reed: one sustained note (measured f0 415 Hz, G#4), re-tuned per grain to D/A

s-timbal.prompt: A single deep hit on a large traditional bass drum played with a mallet, warm boom with a short stone room tail
s-timbal.use: the tronc's pulse (layered with a synth skin, at 1.06 = D), far timbal under hands in wait

sfx-crown.prompt: A crowd in a town square erupting in joyful cheers and applause after a breathless silence, outdoors, festive
sfx-crown.use: crown: the square roars, on the crowd rotor

sfx-fall.prompt: A wall of ceramic tiles collapsing and shattering on stone, tumbling shards, then settling debris and silence

sfx-tile.prompt: A single ceramic tile set into place on stone with a firm, dry, satisfying click and a short clay resonance
